answer: Time-locked bonds with decay binds each identity to capital locked 30 days with linear release. An attacker needs 1,000 bonds per identity because every clone parks non-recoverable collateral, so 500 clones require 500,000 bonds. The network enforces this via bond-balance checks at each attestation. The zenith registry anchors enrollment, the inlet attestation log records each proof, and the mirror checkpoint finalizes penalties.
